job.job_description:
Required Skills

24 years of professional experience in Software Development, AI Development, Automation, or a closely related

technical role.

Strong programming knowledge, preferably in Python.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI / LLMs.
Practical experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, or equivalent platforms.
Good understanding of Prompt Engineering.
Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and third-party integrations.
Understanding of software development fundamentals, debugging, and version control.
Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Replit, Claude Code, or similar tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good understanding of data structures, programming logic, and application workflows.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.




Good to Have

Experience building AI agents or agentic workflows.
Hands-on experience with RAG applications.
Knowledge of vector databases and embeddings.
Experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google Gemini.
Experience with n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar automation platforms.
Knowledge of SQL and databases.
Familiarity with Git/GitHub.
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, or similar Python frameworks.
Exposure to cloud platforms or deployment tools such as Vercel, Replit, AWS, or Azure.
Experience developing AI-powered chatbots, copilots, internal tools, or automation solutions.
Understanding of AI evaluation, prompt testing, and model performance optimization.
